subject: Strategic buying path & risk acceptance - call recap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@skylab.co>, Michael Chen <mchen@skylab.co>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-15T15:02:00Z
Subject: Strategic buying path & risk acceptance - call recap

Hi Helen / Michael —

Thanks for taking time today. Short recap to align on outcomes, risks, and the procurement path so we can keep momentum with your executive sponsors. I’ve pulled out the items we discussed and proposed next steps below.

Key business outcomes you’re targeting
- Reduce inference cost per query by ~30% on peak telemetry workloads (goal: <$0.015/token)
- Hold 95th percentile latency < 600ms for preview endpoints (customer-facing search assistant)
- Maintain PII controls and audit logging for EU traffic (data residency + retention policy)

Primary pain points called out
1) Current vendor spikes on concurrency causing page-timeouts during morning batch jobs.
2) Security/compliance gap: no centralized audit logs + no separation between PII and non-PII inference contexts.
3) Procurement timeline uncertainty — legal needs clarity on data flow and indemnity language.

Decision criteria you shared
- Technical: latency SLOs, KV cache support for large context windows, autoscaling behavior under burst.
- Compliance: SOC2 or equivalent evidence + ability to run inside Skylab VPC for sensitive workloads.
- Commercial: predictable monthly committed spend with clear overage pricing.

Risks we flagged (and mitigations)
- Risk: Integration complexity with your pre-tokenization pipeline.
  Mitigation: we’ll provide an integration engineer and a 3-week POC plan; step 1 will be a lightweight proxy integration.
- Risk: Legal asks for data residency and auditability.
  Mitigation: we’ll supply our security matrix and a sample audit log schema; private deployment option available for scoped workloads.

Proposed procurement path (recommended)
1) 3-week technical POC (non-prod) — objective: validate latency & throughput with 50k daily queries. (owner: Redwood eng / Karthik)
2) Security review + SOC2 evidence & audit log sample (owner: Redwood security / Lauren)
3) Commercial pilot with reserved capacity (1 quarter) — include commit pricing and runbooks (owner: Redwood sales / Ben)
4) Exec sign-off + SOW and procurement (owner: Skylab procurement and legal)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Action 1: I’m attaching a draft SOW and the security matrix for your legal/security teams to review (SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf, security_matrix_skylab.xlsx). Please confirm the best contact for legal redlines. (owner: Skylab)
- Action 2: Redwood to schedule a 60-minute POC kickoff with your infra lead next week to scope integration tasks. (owner: Karthik)
- Action 3: Lauren to follow up with SOC2 artifacts and a short audit log sample doc. (owner: Lauren)

Escalation lanes (if procurement/technical stalls)
- Operational blocker: escalate to Ben Carter (VP Sales Ops) for commercial flexibility and credits.
- Security blocker: escalate to our Head of Security for a bridge call with Skylab security.

Proposed timeline
- POC kickoff: target Aug 19–23
- Security artifact review: by Aug 25
- Pilot contract ready for Skylab legal: by Sep 10

If that matches your read, I’ll set the kickoff for Aug 20 at 10am PT and loop in our integration engineer.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf, security_matrix_skylab.xlsx
From: Helen Park <helen.park@skylab.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@skylab.co>, procurement@skylab.co, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-15T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Strategic buying path & risk acceptance - call recap

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our internal reading. A couple of clarifications:

1) Procurement contact: please loop Alex Nguyen (alex.nguyen@skylab.co) for contract redlines. He will own the DocuSign flow once we have SOW + commercial terms.
2) Timeline note: our legal team will need the security matrix and sample audit logs before Sep 1 to make the pilot timeline.

We’re comfortable proceeding with the 3-week technical POC. Michael (CTO) asked that we include one session on data residency and network topology up front.

Next steps from our side
- We’ll route the SOW to Alex and legal today.
- Procurement will confirm if they require additional insurance language (we’ll update by Aug 18).

Thanks — I’ll wait for the kickoff invite.

—Helen Park
Head of Platform, Skylab
helen.park@skylab.co
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T02:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Strategic buying path & risk acceptance - call recap

Looping in a couple of operational items we should own while Karthik drives the customer. Quick notes: 

- Security artifacts: I’ll pull our latest SOC2 pack and a condensed audit log sample (anonymized) and drop to the Drive link by EOD Aug 16.
- POC scope: recommend we define the POC acceptance criteria explicitly (latency at 95p <600ms; throughput 50k/day; KV cache hit rate >80%). I’ll draft the acceptance checklist.
- Integration risks: Skylab runs a custom tokenizer that may change token counts vs baseline. Engineering should plan for token-budget buffer during POC.

Escalation policy (internal)
1) If latency SLOs not achievable in POC by week 2 => dev sync + Ben to evaluate committed credit offsets.
2) If legal requests novel contract terms (data residency or indemnity) beyond our standard offer => loop in VP Legal and Ben for executive sign-off.

I recommend scheduling the kickoff call Aug 20 10am PT as Karthik suggested; Ben, can you confirm availability and whether you want the VP Sales Ops included on the kickoff?

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@skylab.co>, Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@skylab.co>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, mchen@skylab.co
Date: 2027-08-16T10:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Strategic buying path & risk acceptance - call recap

Thanks all — confirming the plan and action owners: 

1) Karthik: schedule POC kickoff Aug 20 @ 10am PT; include Redwood integration engineer (Gina Park) and Skylab infra lead.
2) Skylab / Alex: review SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf and provide redlines by Aug 18.
3) Lauren: upload SOC2 pack + audit log sample to Drive by EOD Aug 16 (link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSOW).
4) Ben: be the escalation owner for commercial/credits and join week-2 dev sync if SLOs are off-target.

Escalation lane reminder: if legal requests on-residency-only deployment, we’ll propose a scoped private deployment pilot (timeline/price TBD) and escalate to VP Sales & Head of Security for approval.

I’ll send calendar invites and a short POC acceptance checklist later today.

Appreciate the quick alignment — looking forward to kickoff.

Karthik
